blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) said that lane closures will take effect starting Friday evening, Oct. 2, in some areas in Metro Manila for its ongoing rehabilitation works along Epifanio de los Santos Avenue. In its advisory, the DPWH said that lanes 1 and 2 along Monumento (A. De Jesus Rd.) to Balintawak (Kaingin Rd.) southbound will be closed on Friday evening due to breaking and hauling operations.
